verdict.rationale: Docusign has no llms.txt (probe confirms 404) and no discoverable openapi.json at expected paths, but it does publish agent-oriented developer documentation, including an official MCP server page and OpenAPI/Swagger specs on GitHub that describe capabilities for machine consumption. This is a weaker, indirect substitute for a true llms.txt/agent-doc convention. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt file, a dedicated agent-onboarding doc, and independent confirmation that agents can successfully parse these resources.
